## 10. Notes
- Edge bytes above use periph_bytes_per_buffer*periph_buffers_per_frame (= core_bytes_per_buffer*core_buffers_per_frame here),
  the quantity HailoRT's own get_context_transfer_size() sums (layer_info.hpp:192-205). Check: config 20,519,008 + edges
  18,465,280 = 38,984,288 B/frame; `measure-nnc-performance --batch-size 1` printed 304,564 KB for 8 frames
  (= 38,984,192..38,984,319 B/frame) -> exact match (nnc_estimator_b1.txt; b8: 609,129 KB / 16 frames, same S).
- Two inter-context tensors (conv49 20x20x512, concat20 20x20x1024) have core rows padded to width 24
  (core_bytes_per_buffer 12288 / 24576) but HEF padded_width 20. The inter-context descriptors are programmed with
  frame_credits = get_layer_transfer_size(hw_shape) = 204,800 / 409,600 (resource_manager_builder.cpp:200-205) and the
  buffer planner sizes match that (buffer_alloc_b8.txt: 6,656,000 B/frame). So the real DMA may be the unpadded value:
  inter-context D2H 6,656,000..6,778,880, H2D 6,860,800..7,024,640 B/frame (difference 286,720 B/frame, 1.6% of edges).
  Conclusions do not change with either value.
- fw-actions spans are from one batch iteration recorded by measure-fw-actions (`run2 -m raw_async`, 3 s), 2026-10-08 09:14-09:16,
  Gen3 x1, no warnings in hailort_fwactions_probe.log. Single run, not a 3-run median (probe-type evidence).
